statement.zh: Jarrige 等编《Mehrgarh: Field Reports 1974–1985》(1995) 汇总梅赫尔格尔新石器至印度河相关序列田野结果。
statement.en: Jarrige et al., eds., Mehrgarh: Field Reports 1974–1985 (1995) compile field results for Mehrgarh’s Neolithic through Indus-related sequence.
